name: Bingo
tagline: Call bingo over a meeting. Everyone who opens the invite gets a card.
description:
Call the numbers from one phone. Everyone else daubs a card on theirs. Whoever sent the invite calls — and can hand the ball to anyone in the room, or take it back. Open it in a GifOS meeting and you already have the voice.

On your own, you call and daub on this device. Your card is saved with the app.

A line, a column, a diagonal, or the four corners is bingo. The first honest line takes the round.

An unofficial port of bingo by mihailgaberov.
